To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a methodology for the reliability based optimization of vibro-acoustic systems with uncertain parameters, using the Polynomial Chaos Expansion (PCE) method.

1) the proposed methodology for the reliability-based optimization of vibro-acoustic structures with uncertain parameters is efficient and robust; 2) it is possible to use a reduced-order model in a reliable manner; 3) the proposed methodology is suitable for the reliability-based design optimization of vibroacoustic structures with uncertain geometries and material properties.
- A new approach for robust optimization of uncertain vibro-acoustic systems has been developed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the robustness analysis and reliability-based optimization of the vibro-acoustic problems (or fluid-structure interactions) in the presence of uncertainties.
reliability-based design optimization of fluid-structure interaction systems.
the development of a new methodology for reliability-based optimization of uncertain structural-acoustic systems.

the proposed methodologies are very effective in the optimization of vibroacoustic problems with uncertain parameters.

the proposed methodology is capable of handling the design optimization of vibro-acoustics problems in the presence of uncertainty in a computationally efficient manner, while maintaining the accuracy and reliability of the results.
